original_test_intent: Verify every expected physical/logical storage drive is present at the correct path with approved identity/capacity/firmware/media properties and NVSM health OK.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load expected drive serial/WWN/model/capacity/firmware/slot/path manifest including multipath/RAID membership; run exact `nvsm show drives` read-only; retain raw identity/status/health fields; reconcile duplicates/paths and compare every expected drive; corroborate non-OK/unknown states without mutation.
manual_activity: Storage owner supplies expected drive/path manifest and dispositions every missing, duplicate, mismatched or non-OK drive.
safety_requirements: Never clear logs, initialize, format, sanitize or repair drives
Resolve by stable serial/WWN, not /dev order

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command is applicable but lacks expected drive identities, paths and health semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command from approved NVSM and join every row to the serial/WWN/slot manifest.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All storage drives, all information and every Status_Health remain in scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a serial/WWN-keyed expected-versus-observed table including physical slot, controller/path, capacity, firmware and health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes completeness and correctness objective while staying read-only.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Storage summary or controller health cannot prove each drive.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: One physical drive may expose multiple paths; deduplication must not hide missing paths or duplicate identities.

project_override_considerations: Storage architecture defines expected multipath/RAID topology, capacity units and optional slots.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target drive inventory and health; missing reference inventory is a project input and log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and drive manifest are provisionable; collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Uses stable drive identities and path reconciliation so duplicate names or multipath entries cannot hide missing hardware.
independent_technical_reasoning: Device-node ordering is volatile and multipath can create several records for one medium. Serial/WWN and physical slot are necessary to establish both physical completeness and expected path multiplicity before interpreting health.
